tickets.title: Compare and label mortgage balance source documents
tickets.text: Compare the mediation worksheet mortgage balance with the Teacup Comet Bank portal balance of $482,000 and label source documents before using figures in planning exhibits for Anika Meadowbobbin.
tickets.evidence: The mediation worksheet showed a lower mortgage balance than the Teacup Comet Bank portal balance, so the agreed 2025-03-12 follow-up is to compare and label source documents before the figures are used in planning exhibits.

tickets.title: Coordinate divorce-related financial document package
tickets.text: Compile and organize financial planning records requested for divorce-related analysis. Use only authorized documents, confirm permitted communication channels, and separate planning notes from legal advice. Coordinate with the client's attorney or mediator when written authorization is on file. Compile authorized investment, bank, retirement, debt, and household cash-flow records for Anika Meadowbobbin's pending property discussion with Tobin Mossbutton of Silver Marmot Legal.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to compile by 2025-03-14 the authorized investment, bank, retirement, debt, and household cash-flow records Tobin requested for the pending property discussion.

tickets.title: Obtain Paper Otter Fabrication valuation exhibit and K-1 support
tickets.text: Obtain the Paper Otter Fabrication ownership valuation exhibit, recent K-1 support, and buy-sell agreement pages needed by Silver Marmot Legal to understand Reid Meadowbobbin's 40% business interest for Anika Meadowbobbin's property discussion.
tickets.evidence: Because the shared portal lacked the Paper Otter Fabrication ownership valuation exhibit, recent K-1 support, and buy-sell agreement pages Silver Marmot Legal needs to understand Reid’s business interest, the agreed follow-up is due 2025-03-18.

tickets.title: Coordinate beneficiary and ownership record updates through legal channels
tickets.text: Coordinate updates to legacy beneficiary and ownership records where Reid Meadowbobbin is listed on Anika Meadowbobbin's Velvet Acorn Custody Roth IRA, term life policy, and joint taxable account through authorized legal channels with Tobin Mossbutton of Silver Marmot Legal.
tickets.evidence: Mira’s planning inventory review found Reid listed on legacy beneficiary and ownership records, including Anika’s Roth IRA, term life policy, and joint taxable account, with any changes to be coordinated through authorized legal channels by 2025-03-21.
